messages:
priya.g: Heads-up — ISO audit next week asked for a compact package showing our crypto key custody + access trail for service keys used by inference runtime. They want: list of keys, rotation history, who has been granted access (incl emergency), and audit log snippets. Can owners chime in?

kevin.l: I can own gathering the key metadata and rotation history. Need clarity: do they want raw KMS API logs or formatted CSV? :thinking_face:

audit-jen: CSV is fine, but we need verifiable hashes on exported files and timestamps that match our audit logs. Also a brief narrative about approval flow for granting key access.

sara.j: For approval flow, reference our PR-based RBAC change process (terraform + approvals in GitHub). See PRs: #8421, #8499. I can export the GitHub approval history.

mike.t: For audit logs, best to pull from our central audit_events table + cloud KMS admin logs. Quick command to dump recent KMS admin actions: 
```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:("SetIamPolicy" OR "CreateCryptoKeyVersion" OR "RestoreCryptoKeyVersion")' --project=redwood-prod --format=json > kms_admin_actions.json
```
That includes IAM changes and key version ops.

kevin.l: Adding a SQL snippet to pull service usage from datastore for key usage (will correlate with logs):
```sql
SELECT key_id, user, action, timestamp
FROM audit_events
WHERE resource_type = 'kms_key'
  AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-20'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 5000;
```

priya.g: Perfect. Also need evidence of emergency access / break-glass flows and who invoked them historically. We have one incident last quarter (INC-2026-013) where emergency access was used — include the incident runbook snapshot and the postmortem excerpt.

infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-013: emergency key access granted to kevin.l at 2026-01-14T03:21:09Z. Authorization doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-013/authorization.pdf

audit-jen: For the RBAC control mapping, we expect a table mapping our controls to evidence files. Example columns: Control ID, Control Description, Artifact Path, Owner, Notes. CSV is preferred.

kevin.l: I'll assemble a ZIP with: keys_metadata.csv, kms_admin_actions.json, audit_events_excerpt.csv, github_approvals.csv, incident_INC-2026-013_runbook.pdf, hashes.txt. Will sign the manifest with my PGP key.

sara.j: FYI — recent RBAC change for service-account that runs inference was gated by iam-review@security and required two approvals. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/8499. I'll export review history to include in the mapping.

mike.t: Note: some KMS logs are ingested into centralized logging for 90 days only. If auditors want older rotations, we need to provide snapshots stored in long-term archival bucket: `gs://redwood-compliance/kms-archive/` — I will attach the manifest.

priya.g: Action items: 1) kevin: produce zip + hashes by EOD tomorrow. 2) sara: export GH approvals and map to control IDs. 3) mike: confirm archival manifests and include any logs older than 90 days. 4) audit-jen: confirm format once you see the draft.

kevin.l: On it. Quick question — for KMS key material that is customer-managed (private deployment customers), do we include a note that keys are out-of-scope and provide pointer to customer letter?

audit-jen: Yes, include a statement and pointer to the customer-managed keys policy doc. That should suffice if keys are truly not held by Redwood.

mike.t: Small vuln triage note — during INC-2026-013 we discovered a permission escalation vector in the key-access helper script. Created PR #8932 to harden guards (required MFA and tighter principal checking). I'll link the PR in the package.

kevin.l: packing checklist I'm using: keys_metadata.csv (cols: key_id, purpose, created_at, rotation_policy, rotation_dates, owner), github_approvals.csv, audit_events_excerpt.csv, kms_admin_actions.json, incident docs, vuln-fix-links.txt, manifest.txt, manifest.sig.

priya.g: Thanks. Please drop the final package into `/reports/compliance/ISO_2026/key_custody_package_v1.zip` and ping me here. Also add an internal short readme with mapping of filenames to control IDs.

audit-jen: One more ask: can you also provide a short timeline (bullet list) of access changes since last audit? That helps the reviewer.

kevin.l: Will include a timeline.txt. ETA: 2026-03-21 18:00 UTC.

sara.j: Added a note in the PRs that the exported artifacts are for auditors only. :thumbsup:

priya.g: Great work team — thanks. If anything blocks, @kevin.l please escalate to iam-oncall.
